name: Taskr
description: A way to fairly allocate household chores

paragraphs: Household chores get allocated by nagging, habit, or an "even split" that isn't actually even. Taskr allocates them fairly by time: chores are minutes of work, people are budgets of available minutes, and the assignment is proportional to each member's real capacity — then it puts everyone's load on one screen, so the fairness is seen rather than asserted.
It is built for a household with unequal capacities. A kid with 60 available minutes and a parent with 300 should not get the same number of chores.
